reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the concept of kinetic phase control from P8/P9 with the specific corrosion and passivation findings in Mg-Ti-Zn alloys from P4/P5/P6, and proposes a novel mechanistic link—that controlled Mg partitioning via intermediate annealing sequesters Mg into fine intermetallics, thereby enriching the matrix in passivating elements and improving oxide scale integrity. No passage proposes this specific kinetic-Mg-partitioning-to-oxidation-resistance pathway, nor does any passage suggest the contrasting coarse-segregation outcome as a falsifiable prediction.
